snippet.title: Disney Dreamlight Valley - A Hero's Journey Update Trailer
snippet.description:
Show your strength with Hercules and Phil! 

Wicked weather is wreaking havoc in a brand-new Realm... Help Hercules and Phil undo the mischief behind the gods' anger to invite them to the Valley! 

Play Disney Dreamlight Valley now: https://disneydreamlightvalley.com/getnow
Learn more about A Hero's Journey: https://disneydreamlightvalley.com/news/AHerosJourneyUpdate
